subject: A ninth source family for the Warmly MCP
body:
Warmly normalises every signal into one shape and fixes the ingest surface at eight source families, News and Press through Web and Social. Newsletters are not one of them, so Warmly can say an account was in the news but not which newsletters covered it or who sponsors them.

NewsletterFIT is that source family: publication identity, the article an account appeared in, the sponsors running beside it, and whether the list is rising. The shape stays yours, since every record carries company, publication, article URL, date and sponsor, and the extraction is done by AI on the issue text.

It arrives over REST and MCP, so it can feed the same stream the other eight feed.

If source expansion is on the roadmap, I can send a sample mapped to the field names your eight families already use, so the fit is obvious before anyone wires it.
